article.title: Practising advocate not to sit as Magistrate in certain Courts
article.content: No advocate who practices in the Court of any Magistrate shall sit as a Magistrate in that Court or in any Court within the local jurisdiction of that Court.
article.html:
526Practising advocate not to sit as Magistrate in certain Courts

Section 526 · Chapter XXXIX

No advocate who practices in the Court of any Magistrate shall sit as a Magistrate in that Court or in any Court within the local jurisdiction of that Court.
